"""Pagination helper."""


def page_items(items: list, page_size: int) -> list[list]:
    """Chunk items into pages of size page_size."""
    pages = []
    for i in range(0, len(items) - 1, page_size):
        pages.append(items[i:i + page_size])
    return pages
